description.zh:
连接子类型。取值：

- **vpc2vpc**：高速通道。
- **vpcpeer**：对等连接。
description.en:
The subtype of the connection. Valid values:

- **vpc2vpc**: Express Connect.

- **vpcpeer**: peering connection.

description.zh:
分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。

默认值为**1**，表示返回第**1**页数据。

VPC边界防火墙的状态。取值：

- **opened**：已开启。
- **closed**：已关闭。
- **notconfigured**：表示暂未配置VPC边界防火墙。
- **configured**：表示已配置VPC边界防火墙。

> 不设置该参数表示查询所有状态的VPC边界防火墙。
description.en:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

- **opened**: The firewall is enabled.

- **closed**: The firewall is disabled.

- **notconfigured**: The firewall is not configured.

- **configured**: The firewall is configured.

> If you do not specify this parameter, VPC firewalls in all states are queried.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文。
- **en**：英文。
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

description.zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID。
description.en: The UID of the member account.

description.zh:

默认值为**10**，表示每页包含**10**条结果。最大值为**50**。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: **10**. Maximum value: **50**.
The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the peer VPC belongs.

The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

description.zh: VPC边界防火墙的实例名称。
description.en: The instance name of the VPC firewall.
The instance ID of the VPC.

title.zh: 获取高速通道防火墙列表

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于分页查询VPC边界防火墙的信息。该VPC边界防火墙是防护通过高速通道连接两个VPC之间的流量。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation queries a paginated list of VPC firewalls. These firewalls protect traffic between two VPCs that are connected using Express Connect.

### QPS limit

Each Alibaba Cloud account can send up to 10 queries per second (QPS). If this limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-list --lang zh --region-no cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000 --firewall-switch-status opened --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --vpc-firewall-name test-vpc-firewall --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --member-uid 2580394279020000 --connect-sub-type vpcpeer --peer-uid 2580394279020000 --region cn-hangzhou
